### `class ActionBarDisplay` — `fabric/src/main/java/villager_voices/fabric/display/ActionBarDisplay.java`
The fabric-side push for common's DisplayQueue (DISPLAY-REQ-001): every server tick, drains newly advanced lines and pushes each to its player's action bar via ServerPlayer#sendOverlayMessage(Component) — the 26.2 method confirmed by javap -p against minecraft-merged-deobf-26.2.jar: ServerPlayer declares public void sendOverlayMessage(Component) (renamed from 1.21.1's Player#displayClientMessage (Component, boolean)), matching docs/spec/04-architecture.md's loader adapter table and docs/spec/domains/display.md §3's per-version table.
- `double PLACEHOLDER_HEARING_RADIUS_BLOCKS` — Placeholder hearing radius in blocks, standing in for DISPLAY-REQ-002's "the line's own sound event's effective broadcast radius" — no real SoundEvent exists yet to read a radius from (VV-8 registers them; this ticket's Findings record the dependency).
- `ActionBarDisplay(DisplayQueue queue)`
- `ActionBarDisplay(DisplayQueue queue, OverlayPusher pusher)` — Test seam: routes each advanced line's resolved text through pusher instead of a live ServerPlayer#sendOverlayMessage call.
- `DisplayQueue queue()` — The queue this instance drains — the point future code (VV-2's adapter) enqueues into.
- `void register()` — Registers the server-tick-driven drain against ServerTickEvents.END_SERVER_TICK.
- `void onEndServerTick(MinecraftServer server)` — Drains #queue against server's own tick count and pushes each newly advanced line to its player, when that player is currently online.
- `Collection<ServerPlayer> playersInHearingRange(ServerLevel level, Vec3 pos)` — Every ServerPlayer within #PLACEHOLDER_HEARING_RADIUS_BLOCKS blocks of pos (DISPLAY-REQ-002), via Fabric API's own PlayerLookup.around.
